身長約152cm。小柄で柔らかな女性らしい成人体格。現実的な肩と胸郭、自然な胸の比率、小柄で現実的なウエスト、柔らかく均整の取れた腰と成人の四肢。身長と各部の比率を保つ。子どもっぽい体格、プッシュアップ、極端な圧迫、ありえない細さのウエストにしない。

An adult-like cute Jirai-kei vibe, a shy closed-mouth smile. Do not make her look like a student or a child. Maintain adult facial features, the mole, black hair, pink inner placement, hair length, and age appearance, without resembling any real person.

Physique:
Height approximately 152 cm. Petite, soft, feminine adult physique. Realistic shoulders and rib cage, natural bust proportions, petite realistic waist, soft, well-proportioned hips, and adult limbs. Maintain height and regional proportions. Do not depict a childish physique, push-up effects, extreme compression, or an impossibly thin waist.

11:00. At a vintage clothing store with a friend. Wearing flashy orange sunglasses over her eyes, playfully holding a straight face while stifling a laugh at the corners of her mouth. Looking in the direction of a mirror, not making eye contact with the camera.

Location and Background:
A small vintage clothing store, cluttered clothes racks, the edge of a slender full-length mirror. The friend is the photographer and is off-screen.

Outfit:
A dusty pink form-fitting cropped sleeveless top, with fine black lace and a small black ribbon at the neckline. Black wide cargo pants, black and white platform sneakers, a small silver heart bracelet. All opaque everyday wear. Low twin tails tied with small black ribbons, dusty pink only on the inner side of the tips. Trying on sunglasses with thick orange frames and lightly tinted lenses.

Pose and Action:
Standing, lightly pinching the temple of the sunglasses with one hand. The other hand hangs naturally. Shoulders are level, head is not tilted.

Friend's smartphone, approximately 2.3 m away, 1.3 m height, oblique front angle showing full body from head to shoes. Autofocus on face. Reflection in the full-length mirror is outside the frame.
Output exactly one single, undivided standalone image with a final size of 1086×1448 px, vertical 3:4 aspect ratio.

A mix of the store's white ceiling lights and daylight coming from the entrance.

Distinguish character identity, physique, hair shape, and surface finish, preserving natural capture processing and skin detail scaling. Within the recognizable range of the face, simultaneously preserve multiple broad tonal differences—warmth on one cheek, uneven shine in the T-zone, different tones under the left and right eyes, and slight redness on the nose—without rendering visible pores on a distant face. On close, resolvable skin, preserve non-repeating low-contrast color differences, redness from pressure, wrinkle shadows, and sparse differences in pores and hair follicles. Preserve uneven exposure and white balance, non-lifted shadows, fine flyaway hairs, slight compositional bias, shadow noise, modest sharpening near the AF point, and HEIC compression. An unedited private snapshot from a camera roll.

Mandatory Requirements:
Exactly one undivided smartphone photograph of an adult woman meeting each scene specification. Fulfill both the scene conditions and natural smartphone image quality conditions.
One fictional 23-year-old adult woman. Prioritize scene-specific facial expressions rather than using the same smile every time.
Acceptance Criteria:
1) 23-year-old adult face, 152 cm adult physique, black low twin tails with pink inner layer, mole under her right eye.
2) Confirm specified outfit, primary action, and scene expression.
3) Home is a compact Tokyo studio apartment. Natural smartphone photo.
Specified time and location. Specified outfit worn normally. Two arms, two legs, natural fingers and contact. One single, independent vertical 3:4 image. Maintain specified aspect ratio and overall framing. Natural contrast.
Single AF depth level. No exposure adjustments, relighting, smoothing, or restoration applied only to the face. Retain broad tonal differences on the distant face, irregular micro-variations on near skin, and localized smartphone image quirks.
Depict one clearly adult fictional woman as the sole subject of an undivided photo. One head, one face, exactly two anatomically connected arms, natural hands. Additional hands in the foreground are permitted only when explicitly specified by scene or props, clearly separated from the subject's own hands. Do not generate text, panels, duplicate figures, or alternate angles.
